name: PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk
summary: PT Lovina Beach Brewery Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes alcoholic beverages in Indonesia. The company offers craft beer, gin, vodka, whisky, rum, sparkling agave juices and spirits, and soju products; and flavored liqueurs and white spirits/coconut nectars. It provides its products under the Stark Craft Beer, Kaja, Nord, Arak Dewan, Arak Legong, Aja Soju, Coco Bali, Clarissa, Libarron, Libarron Starry Night, Lion Brewery, 1945, Wija, Bali Slip, Kalagan Whisky, and Arak Bum Bung brands.
